info.title: GhorBD API
info.description:
REST API behind ghorbd.com: property listings for rent and sale across Bangladesh (apartment, room, house, hotel, shop, office, land), with search, favourites, notifications, Q&A, a blog and admin moderation.

**Full integration guide:** `docs/api/README.md` in the backend repo.

## Quick start
1. Pick an environment (Local / Staging / Production). `baseUrl` already ends in `/api`.
2. Run **Auth → Log in**. The test script saves `accessToken`, `refreshToken` and `userId` into the environment.
3. Every other request uses `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`, inherited from the collection.
4. When a call returns `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED`, run **Auth → Refresh the session**. Access tokens last 15 minutes and refresh tokens last 30 days.

## Conventions
- Single item: `{ "data": { … } }`
- List: `{ "data": [ … ], "meta": { "page", "perPage", "total", "totalPages" } }`
- Error: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`. Branch on `code`, not on `message`.
- ids are 24-character hex strings. Dates are ISO-8601 UTC. Money is whole taka (BDT) unless the field name ends in `Minor`.
- Pagination: `?page=1&perPage=12`. `perPage` can be at most 60.
- A resource you are not allowed to see returns **404**, not 403.

post.description:
Creates a tenant or owner account. **Email verification is mandatory by default**: the response then contains NO tokens and `verification.emailOtpRequired: true`; a 6-digit code + link are emailed. Finish signup with POST /auth/verify-email-otp. If the server has email verification disabled, tokens are returned immediately. Phone OTP is currently OFF (`verification.required: false`). Outside production `devEmailOtp` / `devEmailToken` / `devOtp` are included so QA can test without a mailbox.

Rate limit: 20 **failed** attempts / 15 min per IP.

error.message: An account with that email already exists

Submits the code from the verification email. Returns a full session. Code lives 24 h; 5 wrong attempts invalidate it.

Returns the user plus access & refresh tokens in the body (also sets web cookies — ignore them on mobile). If the email is not yet verified the server re-sends the code and answers **403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED** — route the user to the OTP screen and call POST /auth/verify-email-otp.

post.description: Exchange a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair (rotate both on the device). Also re-reads the user, so role changes apply here. Fails with 401 `PASSWORD_CHANGED` after a password change/reset (sessions revoked), `ACCOUNT_MISSING` if the account was deleted, `REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID` / `REFRESH_MISSING` otherwise → clear tokens and send user to login.

post.description: Clears web cookies. Tokens are stateless JWTs — on mobile simply delete both stored tokens as well. To revoke all sessions everywhere, change the password.

post.description: Any signed-in user may post. Upload photos first (POST /media/upload) and pass their `url`s in `images`. New listings go to `pending` (admin review) by default, or `draft`. post.description:
Owner lifecycle actions:
- `submit`: draft | rejected | archived → pending (enter review)
- `archive`: draft | pending | active → archived
- `withdraw`: pending → draft

Only an admin can make a listing `active`. Response includes `available` — the actions valid from the new state (use it to render buttons).

post.description:
`multipart/form-data`, field name **`files`** (repeat for multiple). Max **20 files**, **5 MB each**, JPEG / PNG / WebP only. Server auto-rotates (EXIF), watermarks and creates WebP sizes 400/800/1200/1600 px. Use `url` in `listing.images`, `thumbnailUrl` for cards. Unused uploads are deleted by a nightly sweep after 24 h. Rate limit 100 uploads/hour.

Rate limit: 100 / hour.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from login / verify-email-otp / refresh. Lifetime 15 minutes. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

details.description: Optional. For VALIDATION_ERROR: array of {path, message}. For some 409s: an object (e.g. {from, action, allowed}).

refreshToken.description: JWT, valid 30 days. Store securely (Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences).

phone.description: Canonical +8801XXXXXXXXX. May be null for Google-created accounts.

verified.description: Gate flag the app checks. Currently true for every account (phone OTP is off).

size.description: Square feet. For land it is derived from land.areaValue + areaUnit.

pricePerMonth.description: Whole taka. Monthly rent for rent listings; total price for sale listings; per-night for hotels.

path.description: Web path, e.g. /listings/<slug> — use for share links

hasContactPhone.description: Whether GET /listings/{id}/contact will return a number

contactPhone.description: Admin review queue only — never in public payloads

purpose.description: Optional. Defaults to "sale" for land, "rent" otherwise. Land must be sale; hotel must be rent.

division.description: Optional — derived from city when omitted

amenities.description: Free-form. Web app uses: lift, generator, security, parking, gas, water, furnished, wifi, garage, rooftop, cctv, balcony. Land: road-access, electricity, gas-line, water-line, boundary-wall, corner-plot, pond, ready-to-build.

contactPhone.description: Never returned in listing payloads; revealed via GET /listings/{id}/contact
